༄༅/ /las gshin gyi rgyun gtor shin tu bsdus pa gnam lcags kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba zhes bya

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// las gshin gyi rgyun gtor shin tu bsdus pa gnam lcags kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba zhes bya

ba bzhugs so// ya mā ri na mo// las gshin gyi gtor chog shin tu bsdus par byed na/ sman raka gtor mchod bshams/ rang ya mā ri'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ rang nyid gshin rje'i gshed po'i mdun// thod pa lcags kyi pho brang ni// zur dgu srid pa'i rtse dang mnyam// logs chen bco brgyad nam mkha'i khyon// rtse mor thod rlon khrag zhag 'dzag /mi ro rta ro 'bum du brtsegs// mi khrag rta khrag mtsho ru bskyil// phyogs skyong dregs pa gshin rje 'khrug /ma he glang rgod sgra chen sgrog /du nag me 'tshub sprin ltar 'thibs// keng rus ha bgad phyogs bcur rgyug /mi min lha srin dmag tu 'khrug /rab 'jigs gshin rje'i zhing du gyur// ces pho brang bskyed nas spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid phyag rgya zil gnon gyi// thugs srog dang ma'i 'phro 'du yis// lho phyogs gshin thang nag po nas// ya ma rā dza spyan 'dren gshegs// mdog nag skra ser mche ba can// be con thod dbyug zhags pa 'dzin/ */ri rab ngos dang mnyam pa'i sku// glang chen lpags pa gos su gyon// thod sbrul rgyan can gnas 'dir bzhugs// zhes spyan drangs pas skad cig la byon nas pho brang du bzhugs par bsam/ rang nyid thod mkhar gyi steng du phyin nas 'chi bdag gi spyi bor thod dbyug bzhag /bdud rtsi khar byin nas dam la bzhag par bsam/ dngos su thod rlon rtse gsum mam baṃ chen gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ hūm̐ */ ya mān+ta ka'i bka' 'khor na// dam tshig tshul bzhin srung mdzad pa'i// las kyi gshin rje ma mo'i tshogs// khyab bdag 'jam dpal zil gnon gyis// ji ltar bka' bstsal dran gyis la// rdo rje'i dam srungs las sgrubs shig /ya ma rā dza sa ma ya na rak+kan/ zhes dam la bzhag /hūm̐ */ las kyi gshin rje yab dang yum// gshed bzhi khram bdag bcu gnyis dang*// sha za khrag 'thung rtsis brkos mkhan// be con 'chang ba ma mo sogs// 'bum phrag mang po 'khor dang bcas// khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// dam nyams brkos la btab pa yi// dbang po'i me tog tshil chen spos// zhun chen mar me rak+ta'i dri// sha chen zhal zas rkang gling mchod// thod chen yangs pa'i snod nang du// sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lngas// yongs su gang ba'i dam tshig rdzas// ma gshin 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri// gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// thod mkhar 'khor lo rten rdzas kyi// ya ma 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// oṃ ma ya rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/

pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad/ rū pa/ shapad/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ zhes mchod gtor sman raka bran/ drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs kyi sngags rgyas byin brlabs nas/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ba liṃ/ ru dhī ra/ maṃ sa/ rak+ta/ tsit+ta/ go ro tsa na/ keṃ ni ri ti/ ba su ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes bdun gyis gtor ma 'bul/ hūm̐ */ las kyi gshin rje yab dang yum// gshed bzhi khram bdag chung mar bcas// sha za yi dwags dregs pa'i tshogs// 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do// zhes bstod/ oṃ kā la rū pa 'di gter gzhung du mi 'dug /ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ ya ma sarba sngags 'og ma 'di 'dogs mi 'dogs gang bde yin gter gzhung du 'dug /sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas so// de nas gtor ma phyir spags zhun chen gyi me mar btsugs sman raka sgron/ dgra bgegs dgu+ug gzhug bya/ drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs kyis byin gyis brlabs nas phul la/ hūm̐ */ 'chi bdag nag po yum dang bcas// gshed bzhi khram bdag bcu gnyis tshogs// ma gshin dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams// sman raka gtor mchod 'di bzhes la// sangs rgyas bstan srung dkon mchog bstod// bstan dgra dam nyams bzung la sod// sha za khrag 'thung grong khyer thob// tshos sregs bsnun cig 'bar bar gyis// khos shig sgrol zhig phye mar mdzod// yun gyi dam tshig gnyan po srungs// zhes gtor ma gtsang sar 'bul lam dgra phyogs su brgyab/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis phyi lam bcad do// 'di ni bsam yas dbu rtse'i steng khang rnam snang bzhi sgrom snying mdzod smug po nas mnga' ris paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal gyis gter du bzhes pa/ 'jam dpal snyan rgyud yang tig gsang ba'i man ngag gi srung mar gsungs 'dug pa las/ gong 'og cung zad bsgrigs shing skabs bab cung zad kyis kha bskangs nas gzhan pa'i bsre lhad med par 'bri gung chos kyi grags pas bris pa'o//
